review_candidates.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Developer Analyst
review_candidates.description: As a Dynamics 365 CRM Engineer at Accenture, you will be responsible for developing and customizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) solutions and Power Platform components to meet client requirements. You will implement technical designs, extend platform capabilities, and deliver high-quality solutions aligned with Microsoft best practices. This role requires a strong technical background, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Application Development Configure and customize Dynamics 365 CE modules, including Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, and Marketing. Develop Plugins, Custom Workflow Activities, and Custom APIs using C#/.NET and XRM SDK. Implement client-side scripting with JavaScript/TypeScript for form logic and UI enhancements. Build advanced UI scenarios using PowerApps Component Framework (PCF) controls. Power Platform Development Design and develop Model-Driven and Canvas Apps to meet business requirements. Automate business processes using Power Automate. Work with Dataverse for entity modeling, relationships, business rules, and security roles. Integration & Data Management Develop integrations using REST APIs, OData, and Dataverse Web API. Collaborate on data migration activities, including ETL processes, data mapping, and validation. Quality & Governance Adhere to coding standards and participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality deliverables. Ensure compliance with security, data governance, and performance guidelines. Support Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) practices, including solution layering, versioning, and deployment via Azure DevOps pipelines. Collaboration Work closely with Technical Leads, Functional Consultants, and QA teams to ensure seamless delivery. Actively participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and daily stand-ups. Experience: Egyptian national 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Dynamics 365 CE development. Technical Expertise: Proficiency in C#/.NET for developing Plugins and Custom APIs. Strong skills in JavaScript/TypeScript for client-side scripting and UI enhancements. Expertise in Dataverse schema design, entity modeling, and security roles. Hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and PCF controls. Familiarity with Azure services, such as Azure Functions and Logic Apps, for integration. Understanding of ALM and CI/CD practices using Azure DevOps. Preferred Skills: Experience with Dynamics 365 modules, including Omnichannel, Field Service, or Marketing. Certifications (Preferred) Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400) Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Service/Sales Functional Consultant (MB-230/MB-210) Knowledge of Copilot Studio and AI Builder for enhancing CRM capabilities. Exposure to performance tuning and troubleshooting in Dynamics 365 CE environments. review_candidates.title: Machinery Senior Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Nama is a major Middle Eastern group of companies acting as an agent, distributor, and producer of high-quality industrial products. The organization focuses on serving the industrial community by providing a broad spectrum of solutions that address needs across the value chain. Nama supports its clients with raw materials, machinery and equipment, engineering services, training, and spare parts to help maintain efficient and reliable operations. The company aims to be a comprehensive partner for the industries it serves, offering integrated support both horizontally and vertically. This commitment to full-service support creates opportunities for team members to work on diverse technical and commercial projects. Role Description The Machinery Senior Sales Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This role is responsible for identifying and developing machinery sales opportunities, building relationships with industrial clients, and providing technical guidance on suitable equipment solutions. Daily tasks include meeting with existing and prospective customers, preparing and delivering technical and commercial proposals, and coordinating pricing, quotations, and tenders. The role also involves collaborating with engineering and technical support teams to ensure accurate equipment selection, installation follow-up, and after-sales support. The Machinery Senior Sales Engineer will monitor market trends, competitors, and customer feedback, and will contribute to sales planning, forecasting, and continuous improvement of the machinery portfolio. Qualifications Strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills, with the ability to understand machinery specifications and translate them into customer solutions. Proficiency in Sales and Customer Service, including prospecting, negotiation, account management, and maintaining long-term client relationships. Excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal, for presenting technical information clearly and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field. Proven experience in machinery or industrial equipment sales within the manufacturing or industrial sector. Ability to interpret technical drawings, equipment datasheets, and industrial standards. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management capabilities. Comfort working on-site at customer facilities when required and coordinating with cross-functional teams. Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools; familiarity with ERP systems is an advantage. Fluency in English and Arabic preferred; additional languages are a plus.
